sender.ms: Nombor tidak dikenali atau iklan Facebook yang menawarkan kerja sambilan, kemudian kumpulan WhatsApp atau Telegram
sender.en: An unknown number or a Facebook ad offering part-time work, then a WhatsApp or Telegram group

name.ms: Kerja sambilan “like, follow, rating”: dibayar sikit dulu, kemudian kena “deposit” untuk tugasan
name.en: Part-time “like, follow, rating” job: small pay first, then a “deposit” for tasks

how.ms: Anda ditawarkan kerja sambilan yang mudah dengan bayaran lumayan, seperti menekan “like”, mengikuti akaun media sosial atau memberi rating, melalui WhatsApp atau Telegram daripada nombor tidak dikenali. Selepas beberapa tugasan pertama, anda benar-benar dibayar sedikit komisen untuk membina kepercayaan. Kemudian tugasan seterusnya memerlukan anda memindahkan wang dahulu, kononnya modal, deposit atau yuran latihan, dengan janji komisen yang lebih tinggi. Bukit Aman mencatatkan 8,911 kes penipuan kerja sambilan dengan kerugian RM222 juta pada 2025.
how.en: You are offered easy part-time work with high pay, such as “liking” posts, following social media accounts or giving ratings, through WhatsApp or Telegram from an unknown number. After the first few tasks you really are paid a small commission to build trust. Then the next tasks require you to transfer money first, supposedly capital, a deposit or a training fee, with the promise of a bigger commission. Bukit Aman recorded 8,911 part-time job scam cases with RM222 million in losses in 2025.

text.ms: Tawaran kerja sambilan mudah dengan gaji tinggi daripada nombor tidak dikenali atau iklan.
text.en: An easy, well-paid part-time job offer from an unknown number or an ad.

text.ms: Anda dimasukkan ke kumpulan WhatsApp atau Telegram dan dibayar komisen kecil untuk tugasan pertama.
text.en: You are added to a WhatsApp or Telegram group and paid a small commission for the first tasks.

text.ms: Tugasan seterusnya memerlukan anda memindahkan wang dahulu untuk “komisen lebih tinggi”.
text.en: The next tasks require you to transfer money first for a “higher commission”.

text.ms: Untuk mengeluarkan wang, anda diminta membayar lagi, sehingga anda sedar ditipu.
text.en: To withdraw your money you are asked to pay again, until you realise it is a scam.

text.ms: Hai, saya Aina dari bahagian HR. Kami cari pekerja sambilan untuk like dan follow akaun TikTok kedai online, RM10 setiap tugasan, sehari boleh dapat RM300. Boleh buat dari rumah. Kalau berminat saya masukkan dalam group Telegram ya.
text.en: Hi, I'm Aina from HR. We are looking for part-time workers to like and follow online shops' TikTok accounts, RM10 per task, you can earn RM300 a day. You can work from home. If you are interested I'll add you to the Telegram group.

text.ms: Tahniah, tugasan 1 hingga 3 selesai, komisen RM45 sudah dibayar ✅ Tugasan VIP seterusnya: deposit RM800 dahulu, dapat semula RM1,120 dalam 30 minit. Slot terhad, sila transfer sekarang.
text.en: Congratulations, tasks 1 to 3 are done, RM45 commission has been paid ✅ Next VIP task: deposit RM800 first, get back RM1,120 within 30 minutes. Limited slots, please transfer now.

ms: Gaji yang terlalu tinggi untuk kerja yang sangat mudah.
Tawaran hanya melalui WhatsApp atau Telegram, tanpa e-mel syarikat atau portal kerja.
Majikan yang meminta anda membayar deposit, yuran latihan atau modal dahulu.
en: Pay that is far too high for very simple work.
An offer made only through WhatsApp or Telegram, with no company email or job portal.
An employer who asks you to pay a deposit, training fee or capital first.

ms: Jangan pindahkan wang kepada “majikan”. Majikan sebenar tidak meminta bayaran sebelum anda bekerja.
Cari kerja melalui portal yang diiktiraf atau laman rasmi syarikat, dan semak akaun bank di Semak Mule.
Jika sudah memindahkan wang, hubungi 997 dan bank anda segera.
en: Don't transfer money to an “employer”. Real employers don't ask for payment before you start work.
Look for jobs through recognised portals or the company's official site, and check bank accounts on Semak Mule.
If you have already sent money, call 997 and your bank straight away.

sources.title: Dungun engineer loses RM102,100 in elaborate fake job scam
Steep rise in part-time job scams last year, says Bukit Aman commercial crime chief
'Job scam' cases; PDRM receives 1,537 reports in three months

story.ms: Seorang jurutera berusia 34 tahun di Dungun dimasukkan ke kumpulan WhatsApp bernama “feedback & rating (2026)” selepas menekan iklan Facebook. Dia menerima RM310 untuk tugasan pertama, kemudian diminta membuat sumbangan wang untuk tugasan di Telegram. Dia membuat 11 pindahan ke tujuh akaun bank, berjumlah RM102,100.
story.en: A 34-year-old engineer in Dungun was added to a WhatsApp group called “feedback & rating (2026)” after tapping a Facebook ad. She received RM310 for her first tasks, then was asked to pay money in for tasks on Telegram. She made 11 transfers to seven bank accounts, totalling RM102,100.
